rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a document or electronic item proving someone’s identity, status, or entitlement.

example.english: You need to show a credential at the entrance to prove you are entitled to go in.
example.traditional: 入場嗰陣要出示證件，證明你有資格入去。
example.jyutping: jap6 coeng4 go2 zan6 jiu3 ceot1 si6 zing3 gin2 zing3 ming4 nei5 jau5 zi1 gaak3 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize that the credential is documentary proof, especially in an official request.

example.english: To apply for this programme, please submit the credential together with your application.
example.traditional: 申請呢個計劃，請連同證明文件一齊遞交。
example.jyutping: san1 cing2 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 cing2 lin4 tung4 zing3 ming4 man4 gin2 jat1 cai4 dai6 gaau1
